property_summary: After any successful payable fallback call sending exactly 10 ether, the reference contract stores pastBlockTime equal to the call's block.timestamp (a time-based value), whereas the mutant stores block.number so there exist inputs (timestamps/blocks) where pastBlockTime != block.timestamp and thus the property is violated.
change_summary: Change assignment to set pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp, producing a different stored value observable via the public getter.
